button.needXp: Not enough XP to level up ({needed} more needed)
button.levelLocked: Use the Level-Up Wizard to change your level

header.name: {actorName} is reaching level {targetLevel}!
header.description: Here's what you gain. Make your choices below, then apply the level-up.
header.levelJump: The level was raised from {previousLevel} to {targetLevel} in one step. Choices for every level in between are shown together.

menu.nothingToChoose: There are no choices to make at this level. Review your new class features below and apply the level-up.

feats.missedHeader: Empty feat slots from earlier levels ({count})
feats.missedHint: These slots were never filled. They're optional: fill any you like now.

skillIncreases.label: Increase
skillIncreases.hint: Raise one skill by one rank. At this level a skill can reach {rank}.

attributeBoosts.label: Boost {count} different attributes.
attributeBoosts.gradualLabel: Gradual boosts: boost {count} attribute(s) from the level {set} set.
attributeBoosts.partialHint: This attribute is already +4 or higher, so this boost only counts as half. A second boost later raises the modifier.
attributeBoosts.manual: This character uses manually entered attribute modifiers, so the wizard skips attribute boosts. Update them on the character sheet.

intBonus.hint: Your Intelligence modifier went up: become trained in one additional skill (and learn one more language below).

languages.hint: You can learn more languages. Pick them now or later on the character sheet.
languages.label: Language

class.hint: These are added to your character automatically.

spellcasting.slots: Spell slots and repertoires aren't automated. Review them on the Spellcasting tab for:

confirmDialog.title: Confirm Level-Up
confirmDialog.content: Apply these changes to {actorName} and level up to {targetLevel}?
confirmDialog.skipped: These choices are left empty and can be filled in later on the character sheet:

selector.title: {group}: Level {level}
selector.pickHint: Pick a feat on the left to read it here. Double-click a feat to choose it straight away.

prerequisites.unknown: Some prerequisites can't be checked automatically
prerequisites.dedicationRule: Two other feats from your {dedication} archetype first (you have {count})

history.title: Level-Up History
history.undoConfirm: Undo the last level-up of {actorName}? The feats it added are removed and the level goes back from {fromLevel} to {toLevel}. Skill ranks, attribute boosts, languages and XP are restored.
history.undoConfirmManual: Undo the last level-up of {actorName}? The feats it added are removed, and skill ranks, attribute boosts, languages and XP are restored. The level stays at {fromLevel} because it was changed by hand.

showButton.name: Enable Level-Up Button
showButton.hint: Show a Level-Up button on character sheets. When disabled, the wizard opens automatically after a character's level is raised manually.

buttonPlacement.name: Level-Up Button Placement
buttonPlacement.hint: Where the Level-Up button appears: next to the character's level, or in the window's header.

sortMethod.name: Feat Sorting
sortMethod.hint: How feats are sorted by default in the feat picker.

prerequisiteMode.name: Prerequisite Checking
prerequisiteMode.hint: Check feat prerequisites against the character and mark each feat as met, not met, or not checkable. Checks are a guide only: nothing is blocked.

hideUnmetPrerequisites.name: Hide Feats with Unmet Prerequisites
hideUnmetPrerequisites.hint: Default for the feat picker's "hide unmet prerequisites" filter. Feats whose prerequisites can't be checked are always shown.

skillInfo.name: Skill Increase Info
skillInfo.hint: How much information to show in skill selections.

options.nameWithModAndRank: Name, modifier and rank change (Nature +12 (Expert → Master))

disableLevelInput.name: Lock Level Field
disableLevelInput.hint: Disable the level field on character sheets so the wizard is the way to level up. Applies even when the XP requirement isn't met.

requireAllChoices.name: Require All Choices
requireAllChoices.hint: When enabled, every feat slot, skill increase and boost must be chosen before applying a level-up. Disable to let players leave choices empty and fill them in later.

allowPlayerUndo.name: Allow Players to Undo Level-Ups
allowPlayerUndo.hint: When enabled, players can undo their character's most recent level-up. The GM can always undo.

sendGMWhispers.name: Send Reminder Whispers to GM
sendGMWhispers.hint: Also whisper the reminders about manual updates (such as spell slots) to the GM.

additionalCompendiums.name: Additional Feat Compendiums
additionalCompendiums.hint: Feats come from every compendium selected in the system's Compendium Browser settings. Add other compendium IDs here as a comma-separated list, e.g. 'my-module.feats, world.homebrew-feats'.

hiddenRarities.name: Hidden Feat Rarities
hiddenRarities.hint: Feat rarities that players can't see in the feat picker.

options.uncommon: Hide uncommon, rare and unique feats

xpEnforcement.name: Enforce XP Requirements
xpEnforcement.hint: Only allow leveling up once the character has enough XP. The XP for the level is deducted and the rest carries over.

global.noChoices: No new choices at this level.

personal.spellRank: Rank {rank} spells are available: update spell slots and spells on the Spellcasting tab.
personal.featSpells: These new feats mention spells, cantrips or focus spells, which may need to be added by hand: {feats}.
personal.languages: You can learn {count} more language(s): add them on the character sheet.
personal.intSkill: Your Intelligence increase grants {count} additional trained skill(s): choose on the character sheet.
personal.emptySlots: Empty feat slots to fill on the character sheet: {slots}.

notifications.levelUpFailed: The level-up could not be prepared. See the console (F12) for details.
notifications.levelUpRolledBack: The level-up failed and was rolled back. See the console (F12) for details.
notifications.featsSkipped: Not added (choice cancelled): {feats}. Add them from the character sheet if needed.
notifications.missingClass: The Level-Up Wizard needs a class on the character.
notifications.companionClass: The Level-Up Wizard doesn't support companions or eidolons. Grant their feats manually.
notifications.incomplete: Make all the required choices first.
notifications.levelChanged: The character's level changed while the wizard was open. Open the wizard again.
notifications.cannotUndo: Only the most recent level-up can be undone, and only while the character is still level {level}.
notifications.settingsMigrated: Settings migrated from the previous version.

additionalCompendiums.failedToLoad: Could not load compendium {key}. Make sure it is a valid Item compendium.
additionalCompendiums.compendiumNotFound: Compendium {key} not found. Check the spelling in the Level-Up Wizard settings.

notifications.openFailed: The Level-Up Wizard could not open. See the console (F12) for details.
